name: mumotor
description: Mumotor — a warm, all-in-one platform for independent driving instructors: build a beautiful website, let students enroll with a code and book lessons, and run everything from one dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mumotor/backend && npm run build --workspace @mumotor/frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
